_comment: Committed PDK defaults for this repo. Environment variables win over this
file, and sim/pdk.local.json (git-ignored) wins over both.
variant       gf180mcu flavor directory to use (A/B/C/D differ in metal stack)
search_roots  extra directories that CONTAIN variant dirs, searched before
variant is pinned to gf180mcuD per DR-0010 (spec/decisions/0010-pdk-variant.md,
issue #9), per the operator's amendment ruling (2026-08-19T04:35:28Z):
wafer.space's GF180MCU shuttle runs advertise the gf180mcuD stack, and
TinyTapeout's GF shuttles also submit via wafer.space -- every observed
tape-out path for these canaries is D. DR-0010 also found the two variants'
SPICE device models (libs.tech/ngspice) are byte-identical, so this pin
does not itself invalidate any already-recorded sim/ result numerically
-- layout/ artifacts (originally drawn against gf180mcuC) have since been
regenerated and re-signed off against gf180mcuD (issue #127, closed, DR-0010's
amendment; see DR-0010's Consequences and sim/README.md's 'PDK variant'
